architecture.hexagonal: Viewer driving adapter → design_viewer_close Tauri input → DispatchHost application preview owner → detached mock record; native identity and provider close observations enter through declared test seams
architecture.dependencies: UI → command → DispatchHost → preview record. DocumentSession remains sole content/history/baseline SSOT; no new product port approved. Native/provider seams here are proposed document contracts.
architecture.ownership: Application owns preview records; native lifecycle owns actual consumer/window/session/epoch. UI owns only mirror.

architecture.transaction: resolve same native tuple → provider atomic retire one preview → typed closed proof → recheck current delivery tuple → UI Closed. Late/missing response never reopens or retries. Provider commit atomicity is a premise.
